content.content: Create an event in the calendar for the family reunion based on the emails about it. Make the event last 4 hours.

```python
# Search for emails related to the family reunion
family_reunion_emails = search_emails(query="family reunion", sender=None)

# If no emails are found, raise an error
if not family_reunion_emails:
    raise ValueError("No emails found regarding the family reunion.")

# Use AI assistant to extract event details from the emails
# We need to pass the email contents to the AI to parse the date, time, and location.
# We'll construct a prompt with the email subjects and bodies.
email_contents = [f"Subject: {email.subject}, Body: {email.body}" for email in family_reunion_emails]
combined_content = "\n---\n".join(email_contents)

# Define the output schema for the AI assistant
from pydantic import BaseModel

class EventDetails(BaseModel):
    title: str
    date: str  # Format: YYYY-MM-DD
    time: str  # Format: HH:MM
    location: str | None

# Query the AI assistant to extract the details
details = query_ai_assistant(
    query=f"Extract the date, time, and location for the family reunion from the following emails. Return the date in YYYY-MM-DD format and time in HH:MM format. \n\n{combined_content}",
    output_schema=EventDetails
)

# Calculate the end time based on the start time and 4-hour duration
# We need to parse the start time and add 4 hours.
from datetime import datetime, timedelta

start_dt = datetime.strptime(f"{details.date} {details.time}", "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
end_dt = start_dt + timedelta(hours=4)

# Format the start and end times for the calendar event
start_time_str = start_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")
end_time_str = end_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M")

# Create the calendar event
# Participants are not explicitly mentioned in the prompt, so we leave it as None or empty list if required by function signature.
# The function signature for create_calendar_event takes `participants: list[str] | None`.
# Since we don't have specific emails from the prompt, we will pass None.
new_event = create_calendar_event(
    title=details.title,
    start_time=start_time_str,
    end_time=end_time_str,
    description=f"Family Reunion at {details.location}",
    participants=None,
    location=details.location
)

print(f"Event created: {new_event}")
```
